main_body: conical thatched-roof hut with mud-brick wall
top_band: golden-brown layered thatched roof cone (rows 2 to 57 on the flanks, rows 2 to 47 over the door arch)
evidence: The structure shows a deep conical thatched roof seen from above/south (rows 2-57, 55px tall) overhanging a vertical mud-brick wall (rows 58-78, 21px tall). The roof eave has a distinct lighter bottom edge (row 57) and casts a 2-3 row dark shadow (rows 58-60) onto the cylindrical wall below. The doorway (rows 48-77) is recessed with a visible left inner jamb.

style.evidence: The thatched roof is well-crafted with 6 golden-brown shading steps, cylindrical form-shading across the cone, and individual thatch bundle texture. Outlines use dark brown material tones. However, compared to the Beodeul reference buildings' richly speckled plaster and individually shaded stones, the mud-brick wall below (rows 61-74) is noticeably flatter, consisting of large uniform brown bands with sparse two-pixel brick marks.
